title: Free coordinates of a restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $J\\subseteq\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$, and assign a sign in $\\{1,-1\\}$ to each coordinate outside $J$. The coordinate restriction determined by these data is free at every coordinate in $J$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite set of indices in $\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$
A sign is assigned to each index outside $J$
